patthana16.31:1.1: pītisahagataṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na pītisahagato na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā aṭṭhavīsa.
patthana16.31:2.1: pītisahagataṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na upekkhāsahagato na nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā aṭṭhārasa. dassanattika hetuduke nadassanattika nahetudukaṃ
